title: Luminous penthouse, workspace and living weather
scope: Red felt ball, lighter warm-minimal materials, computer workstation and detailed time/weather animation

sources.title: Stitch

retrieval.query: Weather dashboard showing current conditions with an atmospheric sky background and time of day controls

sources.observation: Stitch editor contains a pale-blue weather mockup: readable condition/time labels; use clear labels, do not treat mockup as observed real forecast functionality.

sources.title: Emergent

retrieval.query: Weather dashboard showing current conditions with an atmospheric sky background and time of day controls

sources.observation: Emergent has a sky-photo backdrop fading into a pale workspace; adopt separation between atmospheric backdrop and readable controls, reject saturated blue.

sources.title: Headspace

retrieval.query: Weather dashboard showing current conditions with an atmospheric sky background and time of day controls

sources.observation: Headspace mood check-in uses weather pictograms with visible labels and distinct choices; use clear state naming, not its mood/forecast semantics.

sources.title: Shooting Stars

capture.excerpt: Gradient trail; randomized delay; useEffect schedules recursive timeout with no cancellation

sources.observation: Full component and demo source read. Adopt fading tail and bounded frame loop concept. Reject frequent neon/pixel effects; independently implement elapsed-time movement, weather gating, hidden/reduced-motion behavior and complete timer cleanup. No source copied.

sources.title: Background Pixel Stars

capture.excerpt: Canvas frame throttling; animation frame cancellation; interval cleanup

sources.observation: Full component and demo source read. Adopt fading tail and bounded frame loop concept. Reject frequent neon/pixel effects; independently implement elapsed-time movement, weather gating, hidden/reduced-motion behavior and complete timer cleanup. No source copied.

sources.title: Vercel neutral tokens

capture.excerpt: light surface #ffffff; muted #525252; dark surface #090909; muted #a4a4a4

sources.observation: Keep neutral UI hierarchy; light stone/palette is a spatial design choice, not a wholesale theme import.

sources.title: Kolon x Anour Showroom
sources.observation: Primary text: warm neutrals, soft textures, brushed metal and gentle light/shadow contrast; adopt middle-value range. Retrieved photo 17 was facade, not interior evidence.

sources.title: Nagano HQ
sources.observation: Primary text and actual Lowres33 photo inspected: pale porous stone beside soft taupe textile and reflective glass. Adopt light honed stone, keep black leather as anchor.

sources.title: Eames Aluminum Group
sources.observation: Primary design story and product sheet: slim cast-aluminum frame and suspended seat. Adopt light silhouette and low back; use original unbranded illustration.

sources.title: Kelvin Edge
sources.observation: Primary manufacturer describes adjustable direct task light, black/white options, 2700–3200K. Adopt slender articulated head and independent local light pool.

decisions.reason: Warm grey limestone floor, ivory travertine table, greige wall with black leather anchor. Clearer material contrast preserves the luxury concept.
Right-side smoked walnut/aluminum desk, silver monitor, low-back black chair, articulated task light, under-desk indirect glow. Preserve foreground for Milky.
Slow independent facade lights, distant water glints, dim interior reflection, sparse clear-night meteors with tails.
Far/near rain, refractive stationary drops and coalescing rivulets on individual panes; smooth drying after rain.
Elapsed-time updates, bounded particles, no hidden-tab rendering, reduced-motion still frame, manual effects toggle; music unaffected.
